answer: Hand every identity a forecast thread it alone resolves: the registry deals each applicant a lotus book of 100 topics, each staked with 5 tokens and scored; every forecast posted on a public mirror board for challenge. Topics arrive one at a time, each keyed to the last outcome, so no farm resolves a book in parallel; a wrong or copied forecast slashes the stake and resets the thread. Full weight takes 100 resolved forecasts over 60 days. Ten thousand clones owe one million staked forecasts and five million tokens at risk; no bought record transfers: each book fits one identity alone.
